news.title: Sakurazaka46 "6th YEAR ANNIVERSARY LIVE" and "Rina Matsuda Graduation Ceremony" (November 15 only) will stream live internationally! Tickets go on sale at 12:00 JST today, November 4 (Wed)!
news.content:
Fans overseas will be able to watch Sakurazaka46 "6th YEAR ANNIVERSARY LIVE" and "Rina Matsuda Graduation Ceremony" (November 15 only) live online!
Livestream tickets go on sale at 12:00 JST today, November 4 (Wed).

[Stagecrowd]
Eligible Regions:
North and Central America: United States / Canada / Mexico
South America: Brazil / Peru
Oceania: Australia / New Zealand
Asia: South Korea / Taiwan / Hong Kong / Macau / Singapore / Thailand / Malaysia
Europe: United Kingdom / Germany / France / Italy / Spain

*Those who purchase a viewing ticket will be able to watch both the live broadcast from the venue and the repeat streams.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――

This performance can be watched live online on a PC, smartphone, or other device.
To watch the livestream, you must purchase a viewing ticket in advance.
Before purchasing a ticket, please carefully read the notes on each streaming platform's site and be sure to check that your device and internet connection can play the livestream.

[Performance Details]
"6th YEAR ANNIVERSARY LIVE"
"Rina Matsuda Graduation Ceremony" (November 15 only)

[Performers]
Sakurazaka46
*Please note that the performers are subject to change without prior notice.

[Dates and Times]
DAY-1 November 14 (Sat) Stream starts 16:30 JST / Show starts 17:30 JST
DAY-2 November 15 (Sun) Stream starts 16:00 JST / Show starts 17:00 JST
*Repeat stream
DAY-1 November 19 (Thu) Stream starts 19:00 JST / Show starts 20:00 JST
DAY-2 November 20 (Fri) Stream starts 19:00 JST / Show starts 20:00 JST

[Fee]
General viewing ticket: 4,600 yen (tax incl.)

[Sales Period]
DAY-1 November 4 (Wed) 12:00 JST – November 19 (Thu) 20:00 JST
DAY-2 November 4 (Wed) 12:00 JST – November 20 (Fri) 20:00 JST

[Streaming Platform]
*The site becomes accessible when ticket sales start.
Stagecrowd [Overseas]: https://intl.stagecrowd.live/sakurazaka46_6th_anniversary/

*Before purchasing a ticket, please carefully read the notes on each streaming platform's site and be sure to check that your internet connection and device meet the recommended requirements for viewing the livestream.
*Services and conditions differ in part between streaming platforms. Please choose the one that best suits your viewing environment and preferences.
*Additional fees may apply depending on the streaming platform.
*The content of the livestream is the same regardless of the streaming platform.

[Notes regarding the performance] *Please be sure to read the following.

*Please note that the performers are subject to change without prior notice.
*Apart from the scheduled repeat streams, the livestream will not be available to watch after it ends. If you tune in late, you will not be able to start from the beginning.
*The repeat streams are rebroadcasts on November 19 (Thu) for DAY-1 and November 20 (Fri) for DAY-2, with the show starting at 20:00 JST. Please note that once the scheduled streaming time has passed, rewinding, replaying, and similar playback are not available.
*Those who purchase a viewing ticket for this performance will be able to watch both the live broadcast and the repeat streams.
*Before purchasing a ticket, please carefully read the notes on the streaming platform's site and be sure to check that your internet connection and device meet the recommended requirements for viewing the livestream.
*Access may become congested shortly before the show starts. On the day of the live broadcast, please access the site well before the show start time.
*Once a ticket has been purchased, cancellations, changes, and refunds are not possible for any reason other than postponement or cancellation of the performance.
*Due to internet connection or system problems, the video or audio may be disrupted, or the performance may be temporarily interrupted or ended partway through. In such cases, we will notify you as appropriate for the nature of the problem.
*The organizer will not be responsible for any problems caused by your internet connection or viewing environment.
*This performance is a paid livestream. All rights are reserved by the organizer. Screen recording, photography, filming, and audio recording by any means, including cameras and smartphones, are strictly prohibited. In addition, unauthorized reposting or sharing on video-sharing sites or elsewhere may result in legal liability.
*Commercial use of the livestream video is prohibited. This includes showing the livestream video at restaurants, halls, or similar venues where a fee is collected from the audience.

[Inquiries]
Stagecrowd [Overseas]: https://intl.stagecrowd.live/inquiry_sakurazaka46_6th_anniversary/
